description: This file declares functions related to tensor memory management and manipulation in the 'at::native::openreg' namespace, including creating empty tensors, reshaping, copying, and setting tensor sources.

methods.name: empty_memory_format
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor with a specified size, type, layout, device, memory format, and pin memory options.

methods.name: empty_strided
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with specified size, stride, and optional type, layout, device, and pin memory options.

methods.name: as_strided
methods.description: Returns a tensor with the same data as 'self' but with the specified size, stride, and optional storage offset.

methods.name: resize_
methods.description: Resizes the tensor 'self' to the specified size and optional memory format.

methods.name: _reshape_alias
methods.description: Returns a tensor view with the specified size and stride.

methods.name: _copy_from
methods.description: Copies data from 'dst' tensor into 'self' with optional non-blocking.

methods.name: _copy_from_and_resize
methods.description: Copies data from 'self' to 'dst' and resizes 'self' accordingly.

methods.name: _local_scalar_dense
methods.description: Returns a scalar value from the tensor if it contains a single element.

methods.name: set_source_Storage_storage_offset_
methods.description: Sets the source storage, offset, size, and stride for 'result'.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Returns a tensor with the same data as 'self' but with a different shape specified by size.

methods.name: cpu_fallback
methods.description: Performs a fallback CPU implementation for an operator, used in dispatching.
